Staging environment configuration for a Sails.js application. Extends the production config with staging-specific overrides for datastores, sockets, sessions, and custom settings.

## Key Components

- **`PRODUCTION_CONFIG`** — Base configuration imported from `./production.js`, merged as the foundation
- **`datastores.default`** — Override for the staging database URL (commented placeholder for MySQL connection)
- **`sockets.onlyAllowOrigins`** — Restricts WebSocket connections; defaults to `http://localhost:1337` with commented staging domain examples
- **`sockets.url`** — Redis server URL for Socket.io adapter (commented placeholder)
- **`session.url`** — Redis server URL for session storage (commented placeholder)
- **`custom.baseUrl`** — Staging base URL, defaults to `https://staging.example.com`
- **`custom.internalEmailAddress`** — Routes support emails to `support+staging@example.com`

## Usage Example

```bash
# Lift Sails in staging mode (NODE_ENV must remain "production")
NODE_ENV=production sails_environment=staging node app
```

```bash
# Configure values via system environment variables instead of hardcoding
sails_datastores__default__url="mysql://user:pass@db.example.com:3306/staging_db"
sails_sockets__url="redis://user:pass@redis.example.com:9562/"
sails_custom__baseUrl="https://staging.myapp.com"
```

## Notes

- All sensitive credentials (DB URL, Redis URL, Sendgrid/Stripe keys) should be injected via environment variables rather than hardcoded
- `NODE_ENV` must stay `"production"` even in staging — only `sails_environment` changes
- See [`config/env/production.js`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/config/env/production.js) for the full base configuration
